Business consultancy

What is process improvement?

Process improvement means changing how work moves from one person to the next. A sensible starting point is a familiar task that regularly causes delays, rework or customer complaints.

In this guide
Map one recent exampleTest one small changeCompare the result

Map one recent example

Take a real order, support request or invoice and follow it from beginning to end. Ask each person what they received, what they had to find out and where the item waited.

Test one small change

An order might stall because the delivery team always needs the same missing measurement. Add that field to the sales handoff, identify who checks it and try the change on a small group of orders.

Compare the result

Measure the same thing before and after the trial, such as waiting time or requests sent back for missing details. Ask the people doing the work which problems remain. If the change helps, update the routine and train the next person.
